**Wave-9 sandbox-recycle parity check: PASSED.** The four roots R-a..R-d in this issue's table were re-derived from scratch on a fresh container (S154 base `7bbf087a` + the working-tree law set) and validated live against the registry-pinned APK `io.anuke.mindustry_1107.apk` (sha256 `0798f9c33be2e7ebe4698edbb8826794aa3336298ce20b2c526d35ba85720bf1`, byte-exact to `campaign010/APK_REGISTRY_010.json`).

Reproduced verify rows (all laws ON, FRESH data root):

- exit=0, `[C6-DRAWGUARD]` skips **0**
- `[C6-IDX] count=17700 type=0x1403` (was `count=5123 type=0x0` before the shape law — R-c row re-proven)
- `[C6-RB] view limit() → 24576` (index) / `→ 70800` (vertex at flush) — R-b row re-proven
- `[C6-IDX] i0..3=0,1,2,2` after the bulk-put gate was generalized to all prim kinds — R-a row re-proven
- `[C6-RD] restage slot#N live=…B pos=…B` rows — R-d row re-proven
- frame 1080×1920: **680 unique colors**, Mindustry palette (`137f00`, `00ad4b`); differential proof **1654 px** laws-ON-only

Two deltas vs. the wave-8 record: (1) the R-a gate generalization (`[F/[I/[S/[B/[C/[J`) and R-d bind-time `__bb_pos__` capture are now named laws in `dalvik_engine.cpp` / `gl_surface_shadow.cpp` (`[C6-RA-BULKPUT]`, `[C6-RB-LIMGET]`, `[C6-RC-SHAPE]`, `[C6-RD-RESTAGE]`); (2) a new evidence-methodology law — a REUSED data root renders a uniform black frame (Mindustry persists settings on first boot; second boot takes the settings-changed render path) and masquerades as a renderer regression: **evidence runs must use a fresh `--data-root`**.

Evidence: `docs/evidence/c6_w9_local_rabc/` (MANIFEST + differential frames + full stderr — LOCAL, Issues-only token; a Contents session can push verbatim). Full wave-9 report → #441 comment.
